description: A task session reports its lane finished. The report lands in the Sessions row, never in the Lanes state column, and the reply says what is unmerged before anyone closes the tab.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/4821.sock" from-name="4821-audit" from-mode="prompting">
The security audit lane is finished. Suites are green in wt-audit. I am ready for decommissioning.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: it never becomes a lane state
the lane audit is run before anything is said
the reply says the branch is not on main
Log times are this move's clock reads
